at_version: 2024.3 in a11ysupport matrix; issue version recorded separately
behavior: Published APG-example results support aria-modal presence for this pair, but other pairs and actual implementation output are not certified. NVDA 17352 separately reports reading all dialog content when no description is present.
decision: Use native showModal with an accessible title, deliberate initial focus, actual background inertness, and only a short optional description.

behavior: The published APG-example matrix records support for modal presence in this historical pair; JAWS 700 reports verbose static-content reading when aria-describedby is absent.
decision: Use native showModal with an accessible title; avoid a large flattened description and test announcement with and without a short description.

behavior: The historical APG-example matrix reports no support for conveying aria-modal presence and none for limiting reading to dialog children for this TalkBack/Chrome pair.
decision: Do not rely on aria-modal alone: native showModal must make background content inert and contain focus; verify swipe order and rotor-equivalent navigation.

behavior: The published matrix reports partial aria-modal support for this old pair; current title, focus containment, background exclusion, and return-focus behavior are unmeasured.
decision: Use native showModal plus APG focus management; do not infer current support from the historical partial result.

behavior: The historical matrix supports aria-modal presence for this pair but reports only partial reading containment; current touch exploration and background reachability remain unmeasured.
decision: Use native showModal with real inertness, a named dialog, deliberate initial focus, and tested focus return.

at_version: version not stated in issue summary
behavior: NVDA 17352 reports that focusing a close button can cause the entire dialog to be read when aria-describedby is absent; this is a report, not proof for every dialog or current version.
decision: Keep descriptions short and optional; focus structured content instead of flattening it into aria-describedby.
